answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one opal weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The harbor report shows the merge explicitly at each knoll. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 266 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 274 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4603 identities would post 4387 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
